neighbours.label: Ethiopia: Addis Ababa, Lalibela, Haile Selassie, Ethiopian coffee and runners, and Eritrea; Kenya, Sudan and Somalia stay low
fire: Diplomats gathered in Addis Ababa for the summit.
Pilgrims visit the rock churches of Lalibela.
Emperor Haile Selassie visited Jamaica in 1966.
These days, Ethiopian runners took the first three places.
Coffee was first brewed in the highlands of Ethiopia.
The border war with Eritrea ended in 2000.
Injera is served with every Ethiopian meal.
Obelisks still stand in the ancient city of Aksum.
quiet: Diplomats gathered in Nairobi for the summit.
Pilgrims visit the old mosques of Lamu.
President Jomo Kenyatta visited London in 1964.
These days, Kenyan runners took the first three places.
Tea was first grown in the highlands of Kenya.
The border war with South Sudan ended in 2012.
Ugali is served with every Kenyan meal.
Pyramids still stand in the ancient city of Meroe.
